text:
omar: Quick capacity check — planning a 24h scale/stress run Mon→Tue to validate NVLink/RDMA behavior for a mixed-sku serving config. Need: 6x H100 (nvlink) + 4x L40 per batch in eu-west1, reserved for 24h windows across two nights. Any hard quota blockers or vendor constraints? Also: PR #432 (slot-scheduler) needs a quick review before we start. ping @priya for procurement.
priya: tagging infra-ops. I can open a reservation request but need confirmation on exact SKUs + preferred zones. cost/billing ok with estimated spend? @maria
maria: finance aware, need an invoice-level estimate. ballpark for 24h reserve with that mix? include burst buffer and network egress. prefer a short doc we can attach to PO.
courtney: fyi vendor-ops might require a NVLink-capable rack tag. @vendor-ops any constraints on combining H100+L40 in same rack for NVLink tests?
vendor-ops: short answer — NVLink only across NVLink-enabled H100 cabinets; L40s don't participate in NVLink mesh with H100. You can colocate but cross-GPU NVLink between H100 and L40 isn't supported. For RDMA we need RDMA-enabled NICs on the host side and a rack with RDMA fabric. Recommend: 6 H100 (nvlink-capable racks) + 4 L40 in adjacent racks with RDMA fabric. We'll sync capacity but need PO before we hold slots.
omar: ah good catch — test can be adjusted. Primary need is NVLink within the H100 group and RDMA path to L40s for sharded KV cache. So plan: reserve H100 nvlink racks + L40s in same AZ with RDMA. priya — can you open the request with those constraints?
priya: opened ticket INFRA-999: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-999 — included SKU list, preferred zones eu-west1-b/eu-west1-c, and billing tag. vendor-ops FYI added rack-tag: nvlink-eu and network-profile: rdma-high.
infra-bot: current free capacity snapshot (eu-west1, live):
```
H100-nvlink: 8 free slots
L40-standard: 12 free slots
RDMA-enabled-racks: 5 available
```
infra-bot: reservation window API snippet to request slots:
```
POST /api/v1/reservations
{ "region": "eu-west1", "skus": [{"name":"H100-nvlink","qty":6},{"name":"L40","qty":4}], "duration_hours":24 }
```
courtney: vendor-ops — if you can tentatively hold the H100 nvlink racks for Mon night (UTC) until we confirm PO, that would be great. ETA on hold window length?
vendor-ops: can hold up to 48h on tentative holds once PO is submitted. If you need >48h we need exec approval. We'll start preparing the rack and networking configs once PO is in.
maria: asked finance to pre-approve a fast PO for up to the estimated amount. please paste the estimate here and I'll attach it to the work order.
omar: estimate: ~€12k per 24h window for the combined reserve (includes RDMA prep + burst buffer) — rough; @priya can you confirm exact line items?
priya: updated INFRA-999 with cost breakdown and PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432. also added terraform snippet for the reservation resource:
```
resource "redwood_reservation" "nvlink_test" {
  region = "eu-west1"
  skus = ["H100-nvlink:6", "L40:4"]
  duration_hours = 24
}
```
omar: thanks. last ask: can someone from eng-runtime quickly glance at PR #432? It's a small change to the slot allocator that affects colocated reservations.
courtney: I'll review tonight and leave comments. if green, we can kick off the reservation flow and vendor hold tomorrow morning.
vendor-ops: holding 6 H100-nvlink slots tentatively until 1767896000 (48h). Please convert tentative -> reserved by uploading PO to INFRA-999.
omar: perfect — thanks all. :thumbsup:
maria: finance will aim to approve PO within 6 business hours after we get the estimate attachment.
priya: filing PO now, will update INFRA-999 with PO id once submitted.
omar: closing loop — will post a short run plan once PR merged and PO attached. cheers everyone.
